IDEA
The words "Diversity and Inclusion" is often thrown around like a fad, like the next new shiny thing for businesses. CULTURE

DESIGN THINKING

To create a brand and culture centered on the human condition must focus on inclusion at the top of its strategy. 

The evolution of diversity has moved to diversity and inclusion (D&I), and now to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). We, at Inclusion Equals, believe that accessibility is also a key foundation for inclusion. We believe Inclusion = Diversity + Equity + Accessibility (IDEA).
